title.zh: 波斯帝国维持“波斯治下和平”

summary.zh: 波斯帝国通过完善的行政划分（20个行省）、统一的度量衡、通用阿拉米语和高效的税收系统，维持了从印度河到爱琴海的广阔地域的相对和平。“波斯治下和平”保障了帝国内部的商业流通和文化交流，丝绸之路西段在这一时期初步形成。

statement.en:
Athens and Eretria responded to the appeal of Miletus, sending 25 ships (20 from Athens, 5 from Eretria) to support the Ionian rebels. This Greek force landed in Asia Minor. The Athenian participation enraged Persian Emperor Darius I, who swore revenge against Athens, becoming a direct trigger for the Greco-Persian Wars. The burning of Sardis occurred in 498 BC, 1 year later than this entry.

For Europe in 499 BCE, “Athens aids the Ionian Revolt” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 雅典支援伊奥尼亚起义并焚毁萨迪斯

summary.zh: 雅典和埃雷特里亚的援军与伊奥尼亚起义军联合，于前498年攻入波斯行省吕底亚的首府萨迪斯，焚毁了该城（除女神西布莉神庙外）。这次行动虽然未能持久占领，但极大地鼓舞了起义者的士气，同时彻底激怒大流士一世，使其下定决心征服整个希腊。

statement.zh: 雅典和埃雷特里亚的援军与伊奥尼亚起义军联合，于前498年攻入波斯行省吕底亚的首府萨迪斯，焚毁了该城（除女神西布莉神庙外）。
statement.en: The Athenian and Eretrian reinforcements, together with the Ionian rebels, attacked and burned Sardis, the capital of the Persian satrapy of Lydia (except the temple of Cybele) in 498 BC.

en: The Athenian and Eretrian reinforcements, together with the Ionian rebels, attacked and burned Sardis, the capital of the Persian satrapy of Lydia (except the temple of Cybele) in 498 BC.

title.zh: 印度列国时代十六雄国并立

summary.zh: 公元前6至前4世纪，恒河流域和印度河流域出现了十六个主要强国（摩揭陀、憍萨罗、跋耆等），史称“列国时代”。各国之间频繁征战争夺霸权，同时佛教和耆那教等沙门思潮在此时期兴起，挑战婆罗门教的权威。摩揭陀国逐渐成为最强大的势力。

statement.zh: 公元前6至前4世纪，恒河流域和印度河流域出现了十六个主要强国（摩揭陀、憍萨罗、跋耆等），史称“列国时代”。
statement.en: From the 6th to 4th centuries BC, sixteen major powers (Magadha, Kosala, Vajji, etc.) emerged in the Ganges and Indus river valleys, known as the 'Age of the Janapadas'.

sources.locator: Section 'Pre-Mauryan states'
sources.excerpt: Buddhist writings and other sources from the beginning of this period mention 16 major states (mahajanapada) dominating the northern part of the subcontinent. A few of these, such as Gandhara, Kamboja, Kuru-Pancala, Matsya, Kashi, and Koshala, continued from the earlier period ... The rest were new states, either freshly created from declining older ones or new areas coming into importance, such as Avanti, Ashvaka, Shurasena, Vatsa, Cedi, Malla, Vrijji, Magadha, and Anga.

en: From the 6th to 4th centuries BC, sixteen major powers (Magadha, Kosala, Vajji, etc.) emerged in the Ganges and Indus river valleys, known as the 'Age of the Janapadas'.

summary.zh: 鲁定公十二年（前498年），任大司寇兼摄相事的孔子为削弱季孙、叔孙、孟孙三桓的势力，倡议拆毁其封邑郈、费、成三处逾制的城墙，史称"堕三都"。叔孙氏的郈邑、季孙氏的费邑先后拆除，费人公山不狃反攻曲阜亦被击退；唯孟孙氏家臣公敛处父据守成邑抵抗到底，鲁定公亲自围城而不能下，计划半途而废。此举彻底触怒三桓，孔子在鲁国的政治生涯就此终结，次年去鲁远行。

summary.zh: 斯基泰人是公元前8至前3世纪活跃于黑海北岸的游牧民族，以精湛的金器制作、骑兵战术和独特的“动物纹”艺术著称。他们不建城市，随季节迁徙，使用带轮子的毡房。斯基泰文化对古希腊、波斯和后来的萨尔马提亚人产生了深远影响。

statement.en: The Scythians were a nomadic people active in the northern Black Sea region from the 8th to 3rd centuries BC, known for their exquisite gold work, cavalry tactics, and distinctive 'animal style' art.

title.zh: 孔子离开鲁国，开始周游列国

summary.zh: 鲁定公十三年（前497年），"堕三都"失败之后，齐国致送女乐八十人以沮鲁政，鲁定公与季桓子沉湎声色、三日不朝，郊祭之后又未按礼制分送祭肉给大夫。孔子由此判定鲁君无意于道，遂辞去大司寇之职，率颜回、子路、子贡等弟子离鲁适卫，开始长达十四年的周游。此后他历经卫、曹、宋、郑、陈、蔡、楚诸国，屡遭冷遇与危难——匡地被围、宋司马桓魋伐树、陈蔡之间绝粮七日——始终未获重

title.zh: 雅典僭主希庇亚斯投奔波斯

summary.zh: 前510年被逐出雅典的前僭主希庇亚斯，此时逃到波斯帝国小亚细亚的宫廷。他积极向大流士一世提供雅典军事情报，并鼓动波斯远征希腊。希庇亚斯希望借助波斯的力量恢复自己在雅典的统治。

statement.zh: 前510年被逐出雅典的前僭主希庇亚斯，此时逃到波斯帝国小亚细亚的宫廷。他积极向大流士一世提供雅典军事情报，并鼓动波斯远征希腊。希庇亚斯希望借助波斯的力量恢复自己在雅典的统治。
statement.en:
Hippias, the former tyrant of Athens expelled in 510 BC, fled to the Persian court in Asia Minor. He actively provided Darius I with military intelligence on Athens and urged the Persians to invade Greece, hoping to restore his own rule in Athens with Persian help.

For Europe in 495 BCE, “Athenian tyrant Hippias flees to Persia” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马平民第一次撤离运动

summary.zh: 罗马共和国的平民因无法忍受债务奴役和贵族的压迫，集体撤离到圣山，威胁要另建新城。贵族被迫让步，同意设立“平民保民官”职位，赋予其否决权和人身不可侵犯权。这是罗马平民争取权利斗争的重要胜利，促进了罗马共和政体的完善。

statement.zh: 罗马共和国的平民因无法忍受债务奴役和贵族的压迫，集体撤离到圣山，威胁要另建新城。
statement.en: The Roman plebs, unable to bear debt bondage and oppression by the patricians, collectively seceded to the Sacred Mount, threatening to build a new city.

statement.en:
After the defeat at Marathon, the Persian fleet tried to sail around Cape Sounion to attack Athens directly, but the Athenian army quickly returned to defend. Seeing no advantage and having suffered heavy losses, the Persian commander decided to withdraw to Asia. The first large-scale invasion of Greece ended in failure. Darius I died soon after, and his son Xerxes I planned an even larger invasion.

For Asia in 490 BCE, “Persian invasion of Greece fails” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 雅典正式实施陶片放逐法

summary.zh: 雅典在克利斯提尼改革的基础上，正式将陶片放逐法（Ostracism）纳入政治制度。每年公民大会投票决定是否进行放逐，如有必要则收集陶片，得票最多且超过6000者被放逐十年。该制度旨在防止僭主政治复辟，最早被放逐的是前487年的希帕尔库斯。

statement.zh: 雅典在克利斯提尼改革的基础上，正式将陶片放逐法（Ostracism）纳入政治制度。每年公民大会投票决定是否进行放逐，如有必要则收集陶片，得票最多且超过6000者被放逐十年。该制度旨在防止僭主政治复辟，最早被放逐的是前487年的希帕尔库斯。
statement.en:
Building on Cleisthenes' reforms, Athens formally incorporated ostracism into its political system. Each year the Ecclesia voted on whether to hold an ostracism; if so, citizens wrote names on potsherds, and the person with the most votes (provided there were at least 6,000) was exiled for ten years. The system aimed to prevent the return of tyranny. The first person ostracized was Hipparchus in 487 BC.

For Europe in 487 BCE, “Athens formally implements ostracism” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
To facilitate his northern expansion and transport troops and supplies, King Fuchai of Wu ordered the excavation of the Han Canal, connecting the Yangtze and Huai Rivers. The canal ran from Yangzhou northeast to Huai'an, about 150 km long. It was one of the earliest canals in China and later became an important part of the Grand Canal, greatly promoting north-south economic and cultural exchange.

For Asia in 486 BCE, “King Fuchai of Wu digs the Han Canal” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 孔子删定《诗》《书》，整理六经

summary.zh: 鲁哀公十一年（前484年），周游列国十四年的孔子应季康子之召自卫返鲁，时年六十八，此后不再求仕，专事教学与文献整理。据《史记·孔子世家》，他删定古诗三千余篇为三百零五篇，皆弦歌之以求合于韶武雅颂之音；又序《书》、订《礼》《乐》、赞《周易》，晚年读《易》"韦编三绝"，并据鲁国史官旧文修《春秋》。这批经他编次的典籍成为后世"六经"之本，中国最早的系统教材由此确立

statement.zh: 鲁哀公十一年（前484年），周游列国十四年的孔子应季康子之召自卫返鲁，时年六十八，此后不再求仕，专事教学与文献整理。据《史记·孔子世家》，他删定古诗三千余篇为三百零五篇，皆弦歌之以求合于韶武雅颂之音；又序《书》、订《礼》《乐》、赞《周易》，晚年读《易》"韦编三绝"，并据鲁国史官旧文修《春秋》。这批经他编次的典籍成为后世"六经"之本，中国最早的系统教材由此确立。
statement.en:
In 484 BCE, after fourteen years travelling among the states, Confucius returned to Lu at the invitation of Ji Kangzi. He was 68, sought office no more, and gave himself to teaching and to editing the received texts. According to Sima Qian's biography, he cut more than three thousand ancient odes down to the three hundred and five of the Book of Songs, setting them all to music; he arranged the Book of Documents, revised the texts of ritual and music, wrote on the Book of Changes - wearing out the leather thongs of his copy three times - and compiled the Spring and Autumn Annals from the chronicles of Lu. The books he ordered became the basis of the Six Classics and China's earliest systematic curriculum.

For Asia in 484 BCE, “Confucius edits the Odes and Documents and orders the Six Classics” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 孔子在整理鲁国史书的基础上编撰《春秋》，记载了从鲁隐公元年（前722年）至鲁哀公十四年（前481年）共242年的历史。该书以“微言大义”的笔法褒贬历史人物和事件，成为中国最早的编年体史书，也是儒家“六经”之一。本年“西狩获麟”，孔子认为不祥，遂绝笔。
statement.en:
Based on the chronicles of the state of Lu, Confucius compiled the 'Spring and Autumn Annals', covering 242 years from the first year of Duke Yin of Lu (722 BC) to the fourteenth year of Duke Ai of Lu (481 BC). Using a style of 'subtle and profound words with great meaning', the work praises and condemns historical figures and events. It is the earliest annalistic history of China and one of the Confucian 'Six Classics'. This year, a qilin (mythical beast) was captured, which Confucius took as a bad omen, and he stopped writing.

For Asia in 481 BCE, “Confucius completes the 'Spring and Autumn Annals'” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 雅典与斯巴达关系紧张

summary.zh: 希波战争结束后，雅典在提洛同盟中的领导地位日益加强，斯巴达则保持伯罗奔尼撒同盟的霸权。双方在希腊本土的势力范围发生摩擦，斯巴达对雅典修建长墙（连接雅典城与比雷埃夫斯港）提出抗议，但雅典在地米斯托克利的外交手段下成功完成修建。

statement.zh: 希波战争结束后，雅典在提洛同盟中的领导地位日益加强，斯巴达则保持伯罗奔尼撒同盟的霸权。双方在希腊本土的势力范围发生摩擦，斯巴达对雅典修建长墙（连接雅典城与比雷埃夫斯港）提出抗议，但雅典在地米斯托克利的外交手段下成功完成修建。
statement.en:
After the Greco-Persian Wars, Athens' leadership in the Delian League grew increasingly strong, while Sparta maintained its hegemony over the Peloponnesian League. Clashes over spheres of influence occurred on the Greek mainland. Sparta protested against Athens building the Long Walls (connecting Athens to Piraeus), but Themistocles' diplomacy allowed Athens to complete them.

For Europe in 477 BCE, “Tensions rise between Athens and Sparta” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 巴门尼德提出“存在”哲学

summary.zh: 古希腊埃利亚学派的代表巴门尼德在其哲学诗《论自然》中提出“存在者存在，非存在者不存在”的本体论命题。他与赫拉克利特的流变论针锋相对，认为真正实在的是永恒不变、不可分割的“存在”，变化只是感官的幻象。巴门尼德开创了西方哲学的逻辑论证传统，对柏拉图和后来的形而上学产生了深刻影响。

statement.zh: 古希腊埃利亚学派的代表巴门尼德在其哲学诗《论自然》中提出“存在者存在，非存在者不存在”的本体论命题。他与赫拉克利特的流变论针锋相对，认为真正实在的是永恒不变、不可分割的“存在”，变化只是感官的幻象。巴门尼德开创了西方哲学的逻辑论证传统，对柏拉图和后来的形而上学产生了深刻影响。
statement.en:
The ancient Greek philosopher Parmenides of the Eleatic School, in his philosophical poem 'On Nature', put forward the ontological proposition: 'Being is, non-being is not.' In direct opposition to Heraclitus' doctrine of flux, Parmenides argued that true reality is eternal, unchanging, indivisible 'Being', and that change is mere illusion of the senses. Parmenides inaugurated the tradition of logical argumentation in Western philosophy, profoundly influencing Plato and later metaphysics.

For Europe in 475 BCE, “Parmenides proposes the philosophy of 'Being'” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 地米斯托克利被陶片放逐

summary.zh: 约公元前472年，雅典人以陶片放逐法将地米斯托克利逐出城邦。放逐的缘由包括他强硬的反斯巴达主张、被指与波斯暗通款曲（此说真伪古今聚讼），以及公民对其权势过盛的疑惧。他先赴阿尔戈斯，其后雅典与斯巴达联手以"通敌"之罪追究，他辗转逃入波斯，被国王阿尔塔薛西斯一世任为马格尼西亚等城的领主，终老于小亚细亚。他的离去使主张亲斯巴达的客蒙一派在雅典占据上风。

title.zh: 波斯彻底放弃在欧洲的扩张

title.zh: 埃菲阿尔特斯改革——雅典民主的深化

summary.zh: 雅典民主派领袖埃菲阿尔特斯在伯里克利的支持下，推动公民大会通过法案，剥夺了战神山议事会的政治权力（包括审查官员资格、监督法律执行等），仅保留其审判杀人案的司法职能。这些权力被转移到五百人议事会、公民大会和陪审法庭。这是克利斯提尼改革后雅典民主最重要的一次进步。

statement.zh: 雅典民主派领袖埃菲阿尔特斯在伯里克利的支持下，推动公民大会通过法案，剥夺了战神山议事会的政治权力（包括审查官员资格、监督法律执行等），仅保留其审判杀人案的司法职能。
statement.en: In 462 BCE, Ephialtes, the leader of the Athenian democratic faction, with the support of Pericles, pushed through a law that stripped the Areopagus (Council of the Areopagus) of its political powers (review of officials' qualifications, oversight of laws), leaving it only the judicial function of trying homicide cases.

summary.zh: 公元前460-429年，伯里克利连续十五次当选雅典首席将军，开创了雅典的黄金时代。他在任期间推行完善民主制度：各级官职向所有公民开放、发放公职津贴使穷人也能够参政、加强公民大会的立法权。在伯里克利的推动下，雅典重建了被波斯焚毁的卫城，兴建帕特农神庙等不朽建筑。雅典成为希腊世界的文化中心和盟主。伯里克利在阵亡将士葬礼上的演说成为民主政治的经典宣言。

title.zh: 第一次伯罗奔尼撒战争爆发

summary.zh: 雅典与斯巴达的盟友科林斯、埃皮达鲁斯等城邦发生冲突，斯巴达率军进入阿提卡，第一次伯罗奔尼撒战争（前460-前445年）爆发。雅典与阿尔戈斯、色萨利结盟对抗斯巴达同盟。战争断断续续，最终以《三十年和平条约》结束。

statement.zh: 雅典与斯巴达的盟友科林斯、埃皮达鲁斯等城邦发生冲突，斯巴达率军进入阿提卡，第一次伯罗奔尼撒战争（前460-前445年）爆发。雅典与阿尔戈斯、色萨利结盟对抗斯巴达同盟。战争断断续续，最终以《三十年和平条约》结束。
statement.en:
Athens came into conflict with Sparta's allies Corinth and Epidaurus. Sparta marched into Attica, and the First Peloponnesian War (460-445 BC) began. Athens allied with Argos and Thessaly against the Spartan alliance. The war was fought intermittently and ended with the Thirty Years' Peace.

For Europe in 460 BCE, “First Peloponnesian War breaks out” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 伯里克利继续推行民主改革

summary.zh: 在埃菲阿尔特斯遇刺后，伯里克利成为雅典民主派的领袖。他进一步推行改革：将陪审员的津贴从每天2奥波尔提高到3奥波尔，使贫困公民也能参与司法；并通过法律允许第三等级（zeugitai）担任执政官。雅典民主制度达到了极盛。

summary.zh: 由于雅典在埃及的惨败和斯巴达的威胁，雅典与波斯帝国达成初步休战协议，约定五年内互不攻击。这给了雅典喘息之机，使其能集中力量应对伯罗奔尼撒战争的压力。波斯则利用这段时间恢复国力，并观察希腊局势以便日后干涉。

title.zh: 罗马设立十人立法委员会

summary.zh: 公元前452年，罗马共和国平民与贵族的斗争进入新阶段。在保民官特伦提利乌斯等人的推动下，元老院同意派遣使团前往雅典学习梭伦法律。前451年设立了十人立法委员会（Decemviri），由贵族和平民各五人组成，有权暂停一切官职并制定法律。十人委员会在公元前449-450年颁布了《十二铜表法》，成为罗马法的基石。

summary.zh: 传统把十二铜表法的制定放在前451–前450年：第一个十人委员会草拟十表，第二年补充两表，随后在罗马广场公布，可能刻在铜板上。它让平民知道规则，却也确认了父权、债务奴役与贵族特权。

statement.zh: 传统把十二铜表法的制定放在前451–前450年：第一个十人委员会先草拟十表，第二年补充两表，随后在罗马广场公之于众，可能刻在铜板上。
statement.en: Tradition places the making of the Twelve Tables in 451–450 BCE: a first board of ten commissioners drafted ten tables, a second board added two more, and the code was then posted in the Roman Forum, likely on bronze tablets.

sources.locator: Britannica, Decemviri, section 'Law of the Twelve Tables', paragraph 2
sources.excerpt: Beginning work in 451, the first set of commissioners produced 10 tables, which were later supplemented by 2 additional tables. In 450 the code was formally posted, likely on bronze tablets, in the Roman Forum.

zh: 传统把十二铜表法的制定放在前451–前450年：第一个十人委员会先草拟十表，第二年补充两表，随后在罗马广场公之于众，可能刻在铜板上。
en: Tradition places the making of the Twelve Tables in 451–450 BCE: a first board of ten commissioners drafted ten tables, a second board added two more, and the code was then posted in the Roman Forum, likely on bronze tablets.

note.zh: 451 年十表、450 年补两表并公布，不压成一年。
note.en: Ten tables in 451 and two more posted in 450; the two years are not collapsed.

statement.zh: 原文没有完整保存，今天只能靠后世法学著作的引述拼出片段。
statement.en: The original text does not survive intact; today it is reconstructed from quotations in later legal writings.

sources.locator: Britannica, Decemviri, section 'Law of the Twelve Tables', last paragraph
sources.excerpt: Because only random quotations from the Twelve Tables are extant, knowledge about their contents is largely derived from references in later juridical writings.

zh: 原文没有完整保存，今天只能靠后世法学著作的引述拼出片段。
en: The original text does not survive intact; today it is reconstructed from quotations in later legal writings.

note.zh: 原文未完整保存，内容靠后世引述。
note.en: The original text is not intact; contents come from later quotations.

statement.zh: 成文法的直接作用是让平民知道规则，并据此对抗贵族官员的任意解释。
statement.en: The immediate effect of a written code was to let plebeians know the rules and use them against arbitrary interpretation by patrician officials.

sources.locator: Britannica, Decemviri, section 'Law of the Twelve Tables', paragraph 3
sources.excerpt: The written recording of the law in the Twelve Tables enabled the plebeians both to become acquainted with the law and to protect themselves against patricians’ abuses of power.

zh: 成文法的直接作用是让平民知道规则，并据此对抗贵族官员的任意解释。
en: The immediate effect of a written code was to let plebeians know the rules and use them against arbitrary interpretation by patrician officials.

note.zh: 成文法的作用是公开规则、限制任意解释。
note.en: The code publicized rules and limited arbitrary interpretation.

statement.zh: 此前，法庭判决依据的是只有少数博学贵族掌握的不成文习惯。
statement.en: Before that, judgments rested on unwritten custom preserved by a small group of learned patricians.

sources.locator: Britannica, Decemviri, section 'Law of the Twelve Tables', paragraph 1
sources.excerpt: The Twelve Tables allegedly were written by 10 commissioners (decemvirs) at the insistence of the plebeians, who felt their legal rights were hampered by the fact that court judgments were rendered according to unwritten custom preserved only within a small group of learned patricians.

zh: 此前，法庭判决依据的是只有少数博学贵族掌握的不成文习惯。
en: Before that, judgments rested on unwritten custom preserved by a small group of learned patricians.

note.zh: 此前是不成文习惯，由少数贵族掌握。
note.en: Previously unwritten custom was held by a small group of patricians.

statement.zh: 但十二铜表法不是自由化改革。它确认了贵族阶级与父权家庭的特权，承认欠债可致奴役，也让宗教习俗介入民事案件。
statement.en: But the Twelve Tables were not a liberalizing reform. They recognized the prerogatives of the patrician class and the patriarchal family, allowed enslavement for unpaid debt, and let religious custom enter civil cases.

sources.locator: Britannica, Decemviri, section 'Law of the Twelve Tables', paragraph 4
sources.excerpt: The Twelve Tables were not a reform or a liberalizing of old custom. Rather, they recognized the prerogatives of the patrician class and of the patriarchal family, the validity of enslavement for unpaid debt, and the interference of religious custom in civil cases.

zh: 但十二铜表法不是自由化改革。
它确认了贵族阶级与父权家庭的特权，承认欠债可致奴役，也让宗教习俗介入民事案件。
en: But the Twelve Tables were not a liberalizing reform.
They recognized the prerogatives of the patrician class and the patriarchal family, allowed enslavement for unpaid debt, and let religious custom enter civil cases.

note.zh: 不写通婚禁令等具体条款；只保留条目列出的父权、债务奴役与宗教习俗。
note.en: No intermarriage clause is added; only patriarchy, debt bondage and religious custom are retained.

statement.zh: 它后来被视为罗马私法的基础，却不是现代权利法典。它把规则写下来，同时把不平等写进规则。
statement.en: The code later came to be seen as a foundation of Roman private law, but it was not a modern bill of rights. It wrote the rules down and also wrote inequality into the rules.

zh: 它后来被视为罗马私法的基础，却不是现代权利法典。
它把规则写下来，同时把不平等写进规则。
en: The code later came to be seen as a foundation of Roman private law, but it was not a modern bill of rights.
It wrote the rules down and also wrote inequality into the rules.

note.zh: 作者判断：公开规则不等于平等权利。
note.en: Author judgment: public rules did not mean equal rights.

statement.zh: 罗马共和国颁布《十二铜表法》，将习惯法成文化并公开，成为罗马法系的源头。十二表法把原本由贵族祭司掌握的习惯法写成文字并公之于众，使平民得以知晓规则；它确立了诉讼、债务与家父权等基本范畴，也为后世罗马法学家的解释留下空间。成文法与公开性从此成为罗马法律传统的重要特征。

title.zh: 汉诺远航：已知世界边缘的航线

summary.zh: 汉诺活跃于前5世纪，率60艘船、3万名男女沿西非海岸探险殖民。他建 Thymiaterion（今盖尼特拉）、在索洛伊斯角建神庙、在摩洛哥建五座城市，包括卡里安要塞与阿克拉（阿加迪尔）；更南建塞尔内贸易站。古代文献说他到达冈比亚或塞拉利昂，可能远至喀麦隆，但现代学者怀疑他是否越过摩洛哥。航行记写在巴力神庙，现存10世纪希腊抄本《汉诺航行记》，自称译自布匿铭文。

statement.zh: 汉诺是迦太基的航海者，活跃于前5世纪；他率60艘船、3万名男女，沿西非海岸进行探险和殖民。
statement.en: Hanno was a Carthaginian navigator active in the 5th century BCE; he sailed with 60 vessels carrying 30,000 men and women along the West African coast on a voyage of exploration and colonisation.

sources.locator: Britannica, Hanno, opening paragraph
sources.excerpt: Hanno (flourished 5th century BCE) was a Carthaginian who conducted a voyage of exploration and colonization to the west coast of Africa sometime during the 5th century. Setting sail with 60 vessels holding 30,000 men and women …

zh: 汉诺是迦太基的航海者，活跃于前5世纪；他率60艘船、3万名男女，沿西非海岸进行探险和殖民。
en: Hanno was a Carthaginian navigator active in the 5th century BCE; he sailed with 60 vessels carrying 30,000 men and women along the West African coast on a voyage of exploration and colonisation.

note.zh: 写“前5世纪某时”和60船/3万人；不写“前450年精确出发”。
note.en: Says 'sometime in the 5th century' and 60 ships/30,000 people; no exact 450 BCE departure.

statement.zh: 他先建立 Thymiaterion，即今天的摩洛哥盖尼特拉；在索洛伊斯角（今坎廷角）建神庙；随后又在摩洛哥一带建了五座城市，包括“卡里安要塞”和阿克拉（今阿加迪尔）。卡里安要塞可能就是今天摩洛哥的索维拉，那里发现过布匿移民的遗存。
statement.en: He founded Thymiaterion, now Kenitra in Morocco, and built a temple at Soloeis (Cape Cantin); he then founded five cities in and around Morocco, including the Carian Fortress and Acra (Agadir). The Carian Fortress may be Essaouira, where remains of Punic settlers have been found.

sources.locator: Britannica, Hanno, foundation paragraph
sources.excerpt: Hanno founded Thymiaterion (now Kenitra, Mor.) and built a temple at Soloeis (Cape Cantin, now Cape Meddouza). He then founded five additional cities in and around present Morocco including Carian Fortress (Greek: Karikon Teichos) and Acra (Agadir). The Carian Fortress is perhaps to be identified with Essaouira on the Moroccan coast, where archaeological remains of Punic settlers have been found.

zh: 他先建立 Thymiaterion，即今天的摩洛哥盖尼特拉；在索洛伊斯角（今坎廷角）建神庙；随后又在摩洛哥一带建了五座城市，包括“卡里安要塞”和阿克拉（今阿加迪尔）。卡里安要塞可能就是今天摩洛哥的索维拉，那里发现过布匿移民的遗存。
en: He founded Thymiaterion, now Kenitra in Morocco, and built a temple at Soloeis (Cape Cantin); he then founded five cities in and around Morocco, including the Carian Fortress and Acra (Agadir). The Carian Fortress may be Essaouira, where remains of Punic settlers have been found.

note.zh: 地名与现代对应照条目；不写“每座城市都有确切断代”。
note.en: Place names and modern identifications follow the entry; no exact dating for each city.

note.en: Says 'possibly on the Río de Oro'; no fixed location for Cerne.

statement.zh: 古代文献说他显然到达了今天冈比亚或塞拉利昂海岸，甚至可能远至喀麦隆。
statement.en: Ancient accounts say he evidently reached the coast of present Gambia or Sierra Leone, and may have ventured as far as Cameroon.

sources.locator: Britannica, Hanno, extent sentence

zh: 古代文献说他显然到达了今天冈比亚或塞拉利昂海岸，甚至可能远至喀麦隆。

note.en: Keeps the layers of 'evidently' and 'may have'; no claim that he certainly reached Cameroon.

statement.zh: 现代学者怀疑他是否真的越过了摩洛哥。古代航海记常把“到达”写成夸张的奇观；在缺少同期证据时，最稳妥的写法是把塞尔内以南当作“可能”，而不是确定地图。
statement.en: Modern scholars, however, doubt whether he really went beyond Morocco. Ancient voyage accounts often turn 'reaching' into exotic spectacle; without contemporary evidence, the safest reading treats everything south of Cerne as possible rather than mapped.

zh: 现代学者怀疑他是否真的越过了摩洛哥。古代航海记常把“到达”写成夸张的奇观；在缺少同期证据时，最稳妥的写法是把塞尔内以南当作“可能”，而不是确定地图。
en: Modern scholars, however, doubt whether he really went beyond Morocco. Ancient voyage accounts often turn 'reaching' into exotic spectacle; without contemporary evidence, the safest reading treats everything south of Cerne as possible rather than mapped.

note.zh: 作者判断：把“可能到达”保留为可能。
note.en: Author judgment: keeps 'may have reached' as a possibility.

statement.zh: 航行记被写在迦太基的巴力神庙里，现存一份10世纪的希腊文抄本《汉诺航行记》，自称译自布匿铭文。
statement.en: The account was written in the temple of Baal at Carthage and survives in a 10th-century Greek manuscript, the Periplus of Hannon, which claims to translate a Punic inscription.

sources.locator: Britannica, Hanno, manuscript paragraph
sources.excerpt: An account of his voyage was written in the temple of Baal at Carthage and survives in a 10th-century-AD Greek manuscript known as Periplus of Hannon, which claims to be an ancient Greek translation from the Punic inscription.

zh: 航行记被写在迦太基的巴力神庙里，现存一份10世纪的希腊文抄本《汉诺航行记》，自称译自布匿铭文。
en: The account was written in the temple of Baal at Carthage and survives in a 10th-century Greek manuscript, the Periplus of Hannon, which claims to translate a Punic inscription.

statement.zh: 汉诺航行的价值，不在于证明了迦太基人“发现”了西非，而在于显示一个海洋网络怎样把贸易站、殖民地和神话式地理知识绑在一起。
statement.en: The value of Hanno's voyage is not that it proves Carthaginians 'discovered' West Africa, but that it shows how a maritime network tied trading posts, colonies and mythical geography together.

zh: 汉诺航行的价值，不在于证明了迦太基人“发现”了西非，而在于显示一个海洋网络怎样把贸易站、殖民地和神话式地理知识绑在一起。
en: The value of Hanno's voyage is not that it proves Carthaginians 'discovered' West Africa, but that it shows how a maritime network tied trading posts, colonies and mythical geography together.

note.zh: 作者判断：把航行放回贸易网络与知识生产，而不是“发现者”叙事。
note.en: Author judgment: places the voyage in trade networks and knowledge-making rather than a 'discoverer' narrative.

statement.zh: 被后世誉为“历史学之父”的古希腊作家希罗多德完成了他的巨著《历史》（又称《希波战争史》）。全书共9卷，以希波战争为主线，详细记录了当时希腊、波斯、埃及、巴比伦等地的地理、风俗和历史事件。他开创了西方历史编纂学的传统，强调搜集材料、考证真伪和探究因果。
statement.en:
The ancient Greek writer Herodotus, later called the 'Father of History', completed his great work 'The Histories' (also known as 'The Greco-Persian Wars'). In 9 books, it recounts the wars between Greece and Persia, and in the process describes the geography, customs, and history of Greece, Persia, Egypt, and Babylon. He founded the tradition of historical writing in the West, emphasizing gathering evidence, verification, and causal explanation.

For Europe in 450 BCE, “Herodotus writes the 'Histories'” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 卡里阿斯和约——希波战争结束

summary.zh: 雅典使节卡里阿斯与波斯阿尔塔薛西斯一世签订和约，结束了持续半个世纪的希波战争。和约规定：波斯承认小亚细亚希腊城邦的独立；波斯军舰不得进入爱琴海；波斯放弃对赫勒斯滂和博斯普鲁斯海峡的控制。雅典获得东地中海的制海权，波斯则专注于内部事务。

title.zh: 帕特农神庙在雅典卫城动工

title.zh: 雅典与斯巴达签订三十年和平条约

summary.zh: 雅典与斯巴达签订了《三十年和平条约》。条约规定：双方各自维持其盟友体系（雅典的提洛同盟和斯巴达的伯罗奔尼撒同盟），互不干涉对方同盟内部事务；如有争端须通过仲裁解决；双方不得拉拢对方盟友。条约维持了14年，后因科林斯-科西拉争端而破裂。

statement.en: Athens and Sparta signed the 'Thirty Years' Peace'.

title.zh: 伯里克利公民权法颁布

summary.zh: 伯里克利推动通过公民权法，规定只有父母双方均为雅典公民的人才能获得雅典公民权。这项法律旨在维护公民集团的纯粹性和福利（如公职津贴、粮食分配等），但也导致许多外邦人和非婚生子女失去权利。雅典民主从此更加排外。

en: Pericles pushed through a citizenship law that restricted Athenian citizenship to those born of two Athenian parents.

title.zh: 德谟克利特在雅典活动

title.zh: 索福克勒斯《安提戈涅》上演

summary.zh: 雅典三大悲剧作家之一索福克勒斯在酒神节上首次上演其代表作《安提戈涅》。该剧讲述了底比斯公主安提戈涅不顾国王克瑞翁禁令、毅然安葬兄长波吕涅克斯而最终殉难的悲剧故事，深刻探讨了国家法律与道德良知、世俗权力与神律之间的矛盾冲突。

statement.zh: 雅典三大悲剧作家之一索福克勒斯在酒神节上首次上演其代表作《安提戈涅》。该剧讲述了底比斯公主安提戈涅不顾国王克瑞翁禁令、毅然安葬兄长波吕涅克斯而最终殉难的悲剧故事，深刻探讨了国家法律与道德良知、世俗权力与神律之间的矛盾冲突。
statement.en:
Sophocles, one of the three great Athenian tragedians, first performed his masterpiece 'Antigone' at the Dionysia. The play tells the story of Antigone, the daughter of Oedipus, who defies King Creon's decree to bury her brother Polynices, leading to her tragic death. It explores the conflict between state law and moral conscience, secular power and divine law.

For Europe in 442 BCE, “Sophocles' 'Antigone' performed” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

It explores the conflict between state law and moral conscience, secular power and divine law.

statement.en:
Samos, a member of the Delian League, quarreled with Miletus over territory. Athens intervened on the side of Miletus, and Samos seceded from the league. Pericles personally led a fleet to capture Samos, dissolved its democratic government, confiscated its fleet, and demanded a large indemnity. Samos was the last ally to dare challenge Athenian hegemony; thereafter the Delian League became fully the Athenian Empire.

For Europe in 441 BCE, “Athens suppresses Samian revolt” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马建立“十二铜表法”后立法完善

summary.zh: 罗马在《十二铜表法》基础上，进一步通过《卡努雷亚法》，允许平民与贵族通婚；通过《阿奎利亚法》规范财产损害赔偿。这些法律调整缓和了平民与贵族的矛盾，为罗马共和国的稳定奠定了基础。

title.zh: 帕特农神庙的菲狄亚斯雕像完成

title.zh: 雅典与科西拉缔结防御同盟

summary.zh: 公元前433年，科西拉因争夺其殖民地埃皮丹努斯而与母邦科林斯交恶，遣使赴雅典求援。雅典公民大会经过两天激烈辩论，采纳伯里克利的主张，与科西拉缔结"防御同盟"（epimachia）——仅承诺在科西拉本土遭到攻击时出兵，以规避《三十年和约》的字面约束。此举使希腊第三大海军倒向雅典，却令科林斯深感被背叛，转而游说斯巴达对雅典宣战，成为伯罗奔尼撒战争爆发的重要导火索

statement.en: In 433 BC Corcyra, at odds with its mother city Corinth over the colony of Epidamnus, sent envoys to Athens for help.

zh: 公元前433年，科西拉因争夺其殖民地埃皮丹努斯而与母邦科林斯交恶，遣使赴雅典求援。
en: In 433 BC Corcyra, at odds with its mother city Corinth over the colony of Epidamnus, sent envoys to Athens for help.

statement.en: After two days of heated debate the Athenian assembly followed Pericles and concluded an epimachia, a purely defensive alliance promising aid only if Corcyra itself were attacked, so as to stay within the letter of the Thirty Years' Peace.

statement.zh: 战国早期曾国君主曾侯乙墓在湖北随州出土，六十五件青铜编钟音律完备，展现先秦乐律高峰。编钟按大小依次悬挂，钟体铸有铭文记录音名与律名，说明当时已能以铸造控制音高并组织成组演奏；配套的礼乐器物显示音乐与礼仪、身份密切相关。这套乐器把先秦的声学知识与礼制实践合为一体，是研究古代音乐的关键实物。
statement.en: The early-Warring-States tomb of Marquis Yi of Zeng at Suizhou, Hubei, yielded a 65-piece bronze bell set with full temperament, showing the peak of pre-Qin musical science.

title.zh: 伯罗奔尼撒同盟向雅典发出最后通牒

summary.zh: 斯巴达召集伯罗奔尼撒同盟大会。科林斯、麦加拉等城邦控诉雅典的侵略行为。同盟大会以多数票通过对雅典宣战的决议，并向雅典发出最后通牒：必须解除对波提狄亚的围困、撤销麦加拉法令、允许各邦自治。雅典拒绝，战争一触即发。

title.zh: 雅典通过麦加拉法令（最终确认）

title.zh: 伯里克利发表国葬演说

summary.zh: 冬，伯里克利在阵亡将士国葬典礼上发表著名演说。他赞美雅典的民主制度——“政权在全体公民手中”、“法律对所有人平等对待”、“个人自由得到充分尊重”。修昔底德在《伯罗奔尼撒战争史》中完整记录了这篇演说，使其成为西方政治思想史上的经典文献。

statement.zh: 冬，伯里克利在阵亡将士国葬典礼上发表著名演说。他赞美雅典的民主制度——“政权在全体公民手中”、“法律对所有人平等对待”、“个人自由得到充分尊重”。修昔底德在《伯罗奔尼撒战争史》中完整记录了这篇演说，使其成为西方政治思想史上的经典文献。
statement.en:
In winter, Pericles gave his famous funeral oration over the war dead. He praised Athenian democracy: 'Its administration favors the many instead of the few; this is why it is called a democracy. ... The freedom we enjoy in our government extends also to our ordinary life.' Thucydides recorded the speech in his 'History of the Peloponnesian War', making it a classic document in the history of Western political thought.

For Europe in 431 BCE, “Pericles delivers the Funeral Oration” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 雅典城爆发毁灭性瘟疫。瘟疫从埃及经比雷埃夫斯港传入，患者出现高烧、剧烈咳嗽、皮肤溃烂等症状，死亡率极高。约四分之一的雅典居民死亡，包括伯里克利。瘟疫严重削弱了雅典的战争能力，是雅典在伯罗奔尼撒战争中失败的重要原因之一。现代学者推测可能是伤寒、鼠疫或埃博拉病毒。

statement.zh: 雅典城爆发毁灭性瘟疫。瘟疫从埃及经比雷埃夫斯港传入，患者出现高烧、剧烈咳嗽、皮肤溃烂等症状，死亡率极高。约四分之一的雅典居民死亡，包括伯里克利。瘟疫严重削弱了雅典的战争能力，是雅典在伯罗奔尼撒战争中失败的重要原因之一。现代学者推测可能是伤寒、鼠疫或埃博拉病毒。
statement.en:
A devastating plague broke out in Athens. It is believed to have entered through the port of Piraeus from Egypt. Symptoms included high fever, violent coughing, and skin sores; the mortality rate was extremely high. About a quarter of Athens' population died, including Pericles. The plague severely weakened Athens' war capability and was a major reason for Athens' defeat in the Peloponnesian War. Modern scholars speculate it may have been typhus, plague, or Ebola.

For Europe in 430 BCE, “Great Plague of Athens” is a traceable node of Disaster change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 伯里克利被免职并罚款

summary.zh: 由于瘟疫肆虐和战争失利，雅典公民大会在政治对手的煽动下，将伯里克利免去将军职务并处以罚款（约15-50塔兰特）。这反映了雅典民主制度下领袖受到民众监督和问责的特点。但不久后雅典人又后悔，重新选举伯里克利为将军。

statement.en: Due to the plague and military setbacks, the Athenian Ecclesia, incited by political opponents, removed Pericles from the generalship and fined him (about 15-50 talents).

title.zh: 伯里克利后雅典政治分化

summary.zh: 伯里克利去世后，雅典政坛分裂为两派：以克里昂为首的激进民主派主张强硬对待盟友和斯巴达，以尼西阿斯为代表的保守派主张休战和谈。这种内部分裂导致雅典政策摇摆不定，为后来的西西里远征灾难埋下伏笔。

statement.zh: 伯里克利去世后，雅典政坛分裂为两派：以克里昂为首的激进民主派主张强硬对待盟友和斯巴达，以尼西阿斯为代表的保守派主张休战和谈。
statement.en: After Pericles' death, Athenian politics split into two factions: the radical democrats led by Cleon, who advocated a hard line against allies and Sparta, and the conservatives led by Nicias, who favored truce and negotiation.

summary.zh: 古希腊哲学家柏拉图出生于雅典的贵族家庭，原名阿里斯托克勒斯，因身材宽阔得名“柏拉图”。他二十岁师从苏格拉底，苏格拉底死后游历麦加拉、西西里和埃及等地，四十岁后返回雅典创办了阿卡德米学园。柏拉图撰写了三十余篇对话录，提出了理念论、灵魂回忆说和理想国构想，其哲学体系对西方形而上学、认识论和政治哲学产生了奠基性影响。

statement.zh: 古希腊哲学家柏拉图出生于雅典的贵族家庭，原名阿里斯托克勒斯，因身材宽阔得名“柏拉图”。他二十岁师从苏格拉底，苏格拉底死后游历麦加拉、西西里和埃及等地，四十岁后返回雅典创办了阿卡德米学园。柏拉图撰写了三十余篇对话录，提出了理念论、灵魂回忆说和理想国构想，其哲学体系对西方形而上学、认识论和政治哲学产生了奠基性影响。
statement.en:
The ancient Greek philosopher Plato was born in Athens to an aristocratic family. His original name was Aristocles; he was nicknamed 'Plato' (broad) because of his robust physique. At age twenty he became a student of Socrates. After Socrates' death, he traveled to Megara, Sicily, and Egypt. At around forty, he returned to Athens and founded the Academy. Plato wrote over thirty dialogues, proposing the theory of Forms, the doctrine of recollection, and the ideal state. His philosophical system had a foundational impact on Western metaphysics, epistemology, and political philosophy.

For Europe in 427 BCE, “Birth of Plato” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 斯巴达将军布拉西达斯远征色雷斯

title.zh: 雅典与斯巴达达成一年休战

summary.zh: 为交换俘虏和争取时间，雅典与斯巴达签订为期一年的休战协议。但布拉西达斯在色雷斯地区继续活动，拒绝遵守休战约定，导致停战破裂。

statement.en: In order to exchange prisoners and buy time, Athens and Sparta signed a one-year truce.

statement.en:
The Moche culture (c. 1-700 AD) emerged on the northern coast of Peru. The Moche are known for their fine metalwork, pottery, and large pyramid architecture (such as the Huaca del Sol and Huaca de la Luna). They developed complex irrigation systems, grew corn, beans and cotton, and formed a hierarchical society of priest-warriors.

For South America in 420 BCE, “Moche culture rises in Peru” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

西西里灾难后，雅典财政枯竭、士气低落，民主制度受到挑战。一些贵族派秘密组织策划推翻民主制，建立寡头政权。远征失败使公民兵与财力俱损，民主的参与基础随之动摇；秘密结社以政变与恐怖手段夺权，限制公民权并清洗对手。内部分裂削弱了雅典的抵抗能力。

把「雅典建立寡头政权」放回公元前412年的雅典，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

sources.locator: Opening paragraph
sources.excerpt: Council of the Four Hundred, (411 bc) oligarchical council that briefly took power in Athens during the Peloponnesian War in a coup inspired by Antiphon and Alcibiades. An extremely antidemocratic council, it was soon replaced, at the insistence of the Athenian fleet, by a more moderate oligarchy, the Five Thousand. The new council lasted only 10 months, but full democracy was restored in 410 and a commission set up to prevent a recurrence.

title.zh: 雅典恢复全面民主制度

summary.zh: 基齐库斯战役胜利后，雅典民主派彻底推翻四百人寡头政权，恢复了公民大会、陪审法庭和所有公职的抽签制，取消了财产限制。雅典民主制度在经历了短暂倒退后，重新回到伯里克利时期的水平。

statement.zh: 基齐库斯战役胜利后，雅典民主派彻底推翻四百人寡头政权，恢复了公民大会、陪审法庭和所有公职的抽签制，取消了财产限制。
statement.en: In 410 BCE, after the victory at Cyzicus, the Athenian democrats fully overthrew the oligarchic regime of the Four Hundred, restoring the Ecclesia, popular courts, and the lot system for all public offices, removing property qualifications.

title.zh: 伯罗奔尼撒战争结束——雅典投降

summary.zh: 雅典在羊河战役后粮草断绝，被迫向斯巴达投降。斯巴达在雅典建立亲斯巴达的“三十僭主”寡头政权，拆毁了雅典通往比雷埃夫斯的长墙，解散提洛同盟，将雅典海军削减至12艘战舰。伯罗奔尼撒战争结束，斯巴达成为希腊霸主。这场战争使整个希腊世界元气大伤，为马其顿的崛起创造了条件。

summary.zh: 卫人吴起早年在鲁为将破齐，因见疑于鲁国贵族而出走，约前409年入魏，受魏文侯重用。他率军连取秦国河西之地，设西河郡并出任郡守，与秦对峙数十年，秦人不敢东向。吴起在魏创建"武卒"之制：以严苛的体能标准选拔步兵——衣三属之甲、操十二石之弩、负矢五十、荷戈带剑、赍三日之粮，半日行百里；中试者免除全户徭役赋税并授予田宅，从而把临时征发的农兵改造成常备职业军。其治军与

statement.zh: 卫人吴起早年在鲁为将破齐，因见疑于鲁国贵族而出走，约前409年入魏，受魏文侯重用。他率军连取秦国河西之地，设西河郡并出任郡守，与秦对峙数十年，秦人不敢东向。吴起在魏创建"武卒"之制：以严苛的体能标准选拔步兵——衣三属之甲、操十二石之弩、负矢五十、荷戈带剑、赍三日之粮，半日行100里；中试者免除全户徭役赋税并授予田宅，从而把临时征发的农兵改造成常备职业军。其治军与变法之术后来随他南下传入楚国。
statement.en:
Wu Qi, a native of Wey, first served as a general of Lu, but left after the Lu nobility turned against him and entered the service of Marquis Wen of Wei around 409 BCE. He took the Hexi region from Qin, was made governor of the new Xihe commandery and held the frontier for decades. In Wei he created the 'Wuzu' system: infantry chosen by punishing tests - a man had to carry a three-piece cuirass, a heavy crossbow, fifty bolts, halberd, sword and three days' rations, and march a hundred li in half a day - with successful candidates and their whole households exempted from corvee and taxes and granted land, turning conscripted peasant levies into a standing professional force. He later carried the same methods and reformist thought south to Chu.

For Asia in 401 BCE, “Wu Qi commands for Wei and creates the 'Wuzu' shock infantry” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 波斯帝国修建波斯波利斯阿帕达纳宫

summary.zh: 波斯国王阿塔薛西斯二世继续修建波斯波利斯的宏伟觐见大厅“阿帕达纳”。该大厅由三十六根石柱支撑，柱头雕刻公牛和狮鹫，墙壁上刻有二十三使节国进贡浮雕，展示了帝国治下包括希腊、埃及、印度在内的多元民族。这座建筑成为阿契美尼德王朝中央集权和多民族文化融合的象征。

statement.zh: 波斯国王阿塔薛西斯二世继续修建波斯波利斯的宏伟觐见大厅“阿帕达纳”。该大厅由36根石柱支撑，柱头雕刻公牛和狮鹫，墙壁上刻有二十三使节国进贡浮雕，展示了帝国治下包括希腊、埃及、印度在内的多元民族。这座建筑成为阿契美尼德王朝中央集权和多民族文化融合的象征。
statement.en:
Persian King Artaxerxes II continued building the great audience hall 'Apadana' at Persepolis. The hall was supported by 36 stone columns with bull and griffin capitals, and its walls bore reliefs of 23 tribute-bearing delegations, showing the empire's diverse peoples including Greeks, Egyptians and Indians. The building became a symbol of Achaemenid centralization and multicultural integration.

For Asia in 400 BCE, “Construction of the Apadana palace at Persepolis continues” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

In return, other Greek city-states were granted autonomy, though Athens retained control of Lemnos, Imbros, and Scyros. The treaty also led to major shifts in power within Greece, with Thebes forced to relinquish its control over Boeotia.

summary.zh: 秦国为了加强中央集权和军事动员能力，秦简公颁布户籍改革法令：将五家编为一伍，十家为一什，互相监督并实行连坐。每家登记人口、土地和财产，作为征税和征兵的依据。这一制度彻底改变了秦国此前基于宗族采邑的管理模式，使国家力量直接深入到每一个家庭。此后，秦国能够更有效地征收赋税、征发劳役和兵员，为半个世纪后商鞅变法奠定了基础。

summary.zh: 犬儒哲人第欧根尼以简朴、嬉笑怒骂批判世俗虚伪，主张返归自然自足，影响后世西方思想。

statement.zh: 犬儒哲人第欧根尼以简朴、嬉笑怒骂批判世俗虚伪，主张返归自然自足，影响后世西方思想。他放弃财产与家宅，居于公共场所，以最少的需要示范不受外物支配的生活；对礼仪、名望与权力的嘲弄，是他检验习俗是否合乎自然的方式。犬儒派因此把哲学变成一种生活方式，而非只在讲堂中讨论的学说。其形象在后世被反复引用，成为批判文明的象征。
statement.en: The Cynic Diogenes mocked social convention through voluntary poverty and frank criticism, urging a return to nature and self-sufficiency that later shaped Western thought.

title.zh: 希波克拉底誓言确立医学伦理

summary.zh: 古希腊医者希波克拉底传统下的誓言，强调不伤害、保密与医德，成为西方医学伦理的基石。

statement.zh:
古希腊医者希波克拉底传统下的誓言，强调不伤害、保密与医德，成为西方医学伦理的基石。誓言把医生的义务写成公开承诺：不以医术伤害病人、保守就诊者的秘密、维护职业操守；这些要求并不依赖具体疗效，而是在医患关系尚未对等时先设定行为边界。

把「希波克拉底誓言确立医学伦理」放回公元前400年的古希腊，可以看到医学变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Attributed to the circle of Hippocrates, the oath bound physicians to non-maleficence, confidentiality and professional conduct, becoming the foundation of Western medical ethics.
